2021-christmas-event-before-talking-to-l.npc: Hello sir, are you going to make a snowman?

2021-christmas-event-before-talking-to-l.player: Maybe, I'm not sure I'd be very good at it!

2021-christmas-event-before-talking-to-l.npc: I want to make a snowman, but I can't reach high enough to stack the snowballs properly.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Hello Buoy and Gurl!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Hello sir!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: How do you know our names?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Really? We get to make a snowman?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: But I want it to be five tall!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Buoy and Gurl think for a second.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Fine, it can be four tall.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Yes, four tall is okay.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: The next one should be big!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: The next one should be a small snowball!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: No, it should be little!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: But it needs to be small, little would look bad.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: My decorations will fit on a little one.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Why do you always ruin everything?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: You ruin everything with your silly ideas!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: So mine can be five snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: And mine can be three snowballs tall?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
What would you both like?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
What are you two going to do for decorations?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: I already know what I want mine to look like!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Me too!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Okay sir!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: We will do that!
Buoy and Gurl go back to playing in the snow.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
Hello there!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Have you started making the snowmen yet?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: He'll say, make them really tall!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Buoy and Gurl wander off, arguing about what size snowman is the best.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!

2021-christmas-event-making-snowmen.speaker: Buoy/Gurl
2021-christmas-event-making-snowmen.text: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.text: Yay! Can we decorate them now?

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.npc: Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.npc: Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.text: You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.text: Buoy and Gurl go to their snowmen to start decorating.

2021-christmas-event-when-finished-build.player: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Those snowmen look amazing!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: What about mine? Do you like it?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.speaker: Gurl
2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.text: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.npc: Bye sir, Merry Christmas.

2021-christmas-event-after-talking-to-la.player: Merry Christmas, have fun!
